name: Deadeye imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes, one of the Magma King's: leathery skin, short curled horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, pale-skinned, one eye squinting behind a shard of glass

poses.stand: perched hovering on spread bat wings, one eye squeezed shut and the other behind a small shard of glass held up like a monocle, a long thin white-hot ember held at the end of its pointing arm
poses.struck: just hit and caught mid-shriek: eyes bulging, mouth stretched open, wings snapped up, body tilted back with cracks of orange light glowing through its skin
poses.dead: bursting apart in a small round pop of black soot and bright orange embers, only its horns tumbling out of the puff

idle.action: hovers almost still, flapping slowly, the monocle glinting

attack.action: leans forward, squints, and flicks the thin white-hot bolt away to the right, then settles

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a yelp, wings crumpling, then recovers

die.action: shrieks, swells with orange light shining through the cracks in its skin, and pops like a firecracker into a puff of black soot and embers
